# Town of Danby municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 6; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Danby, Annual Report 2025 (danbyvt.org): the 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' roster and the Selectboard's own minutes (January-March 2026) seat five members: Bradley J. Bender (Chairman), Greg Heaton, Kenneth Abbott Jr., Steve Haines, and Tom Fuller Jr. The Secretary of State directory (June 5, 2026) publishes only Heaton for Danby and styles him Chairman; the town's minutes show Bender chairing, and the directory entry is stale in that respect.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Janice Arnold as Town Clerk of Danby.
Town of Danby, Annual Report 2025 (danbyvt.org): the 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' roster reads 'TOWN CLERK -- Janice Arnold -- 3 year term exp 2026'.
Town of Danby official website, Contact Us page (current): 'Janice Arnold, Town Clerk.' No published 2026 clerk tally was located; the town's live page presents Arnold as the sitting clerk.

Town of Danby, Annual Report 2025 (danbyvt.org): the signed 2026 annual meeting warning (printed in the report) warned a Town Treasurer election for a 3-year term; the official March 3, 2026 ballot printed Katlyn Parker as the only candidate, and the town's 2026 results tally records her elected.

Town of Danby official website, Contact Us page: 'Katlyn Parker, Town Treasurer.' Selectboard minutes of April 9 and June 11, 2026 carry 'Treasurer's Report -- Katlyn Parker.' The Secretary of State Guide (January 2026) names Michelle Bushee, who no longer holds the office.

Town of Danby, Annual Report 2025 (danbyvt.org): the 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' roster lists the Moderator as Dan Garceau (1-year term), and the town's March 3, 2026 results tally records him elected Moderator for 2026.

Town of Danby, Annual Report 2025 (danbyvt.org): the 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' roster lists three elected Listers: Maureen Staples (term expiring 2027), Marvin Gates (2028), and Byron Battease (2026); the official March 3, 2026 ballot and results tally record Battease re-elected.
Town of Danby official website, Contact Us page: 'Board of Listers (Assessors) ... Maureen Staples-Lead Lister; Marvin Gates; Byron Battease.'

Town of Danby, Annual Report 2025 (danbyvt.org): the 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' roster lists Auditors Lonna Burden (3-year term expiring 2029), Sarah Wilde (expiring 2028), and Tara Goodell (1-year appointed seat, 2026). Selectboard minutes of April 9, 2026 record the board accepting Wilde's resignation (effective March 17, 2026) and appointing Bill Payne and Tom Johnston as Town Auditors until Town Meeting 2027; the two appointed holders are recorded as appointed, and Goodell's superseded one-year roster line is not carried forward.

Town of Danby, Annual Report 2025 (danbyvt.org): the 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' roster lists the Delinquent Tax Collector as Douglas R. White (1-year term); the official March 3, 2026 ballot printed his name for the office and the results tally records him elected.

Town of Danby, Annual Report 2025 (danbyvt.org): the 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' roster lists three Trustees of Public Funds: Shelley Taylor (term expiring 2026), Bradley J. Bender (2027), and Hilda Haines (2028); the town's March 3, 2026 results tally records Taylor re-elected.

Town of Danby, Annual Report 2025 (danbyvt.org): the 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' roster lists five Cemetery Commissioners on 5-year terms: Netanel Crispe (expiring 2028), James Viscusi (2028), Roger Bromley (2029), Hilda Haines (2029), and Shelley Taylor (2030). No commissioner's term expired in 2026.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Danby justices of the peace: Bradley J. Bender, Zachary Fuller, Daniel Garceau, Terry J. Hosley II, and Collette Yrsha.
